snippets.takeaway: Enterprise AI is moving from chat rollout toward agentic workflows, with token budgets, rollout speed, and workflow integration becoming the practical bottlenecks.
snippets.summary: We learn online, we are constantly updating, iterating, and I think the world we're in right now with agents and AI is kind of, like you said, pseudo continual learning. And there's a reason why only 1% of enterprises actually have been adopted by AI, and there's so many workflows out there that are super manual and could be automated and actually increase intelligence based on all of these agents that could be in production.
